name: duplicate-labels
setup: run HARNESS_AGENT=main; wait for two eval agent handles
expected: two native children requested with identical labels have distinct allocated ids
both are observable as independent rows

args.code: const a = await agent('HARNESS_AGENT=child/duplicate-a finish.', { agent: 'blocking', label: 'duplicate' }); const b = await agent('HARNESS_AGENT=child/duplicate-b finish.', { agent: 'blocking', label: 'duplicate' }); console.log(await Promise.all([a.wait(), b.wait()]));
